data.one_liner: Widget that loads cached network images with a customizable shimmer loading effect.
data.what_it_does: Downloads and caches network images while showing a customizable shimmer loading placeholder. It supports configurable shimmer colors, speed, directions, and custom error widgets for failed loads.
use_when: You need to load network images with a built-in cache and a shimmer loading effect
You want to quickly customize loading placeholder colors and directions without writing custom skeleton code
avoid_when: You require complex image manipulation or vector graphic rendering
You are not loading images from the network
strengths: Combines caching and shimmer loading out of the box
Configurable shimmer colors, speed, direction, and error widgets
weaknesses: Limited to network image loading and caching use cases
Relies on external cached_network_image and shimmer dependencies

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want pure cached network image handling without a default shimmer effect wrapper.

alternatives.name: octo_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a flexible image widget builder supporting multiple error, placeholder, and image states.
